pixel_observation.observation: The left pane shows Table ready., Standard table / Leave table, a back button and wide Show hand button. Below are Crown table · round 3, Your turn, Orbit claimed 1 Crown, and Guest/Moxie/Pip seat details. Android Display settings remains visible on the right. No card artwork or private card faces are visible in this viewport.
pixel_observation.layout_note: Show hand fits. Pip's seat details are clipped on the right, with a horizontal scrollbar and Swipe seats to see everyone prompt. A vertical scrollbar is visible; only an unlabeled upper border of the next rounded panel appears at the bottom. The actual hand, lower actions, scrolling and interaction reachability cannot be evaluated from these pixels.
